command.description: The absolute path to the command to be executed.

args.description: A list of string arguments to pass to the command.

quiet.description: If true, timelimit does not output diagnostic messages.

propagate.description: If true, timelimit propagates the child's termination signal to itself.

warnsig.description: The signal number sent to the process when warntime expires. Default 15 (SIGTERM).

warntime.description: The maximum execution time in seconds before sending warntime signal.

killsig.description: The signal number sent to the process after killtime expires. Default 9 (SIGKILL).

killtime.description: The maximum execution time in seconds after warntime before sending killsig.
